description: A comprehensive, production-ready .NET 8 microservice template implementing Clean Architecture with CQRS, MediatR, Docker, Kubernetes, health checks, structured logging, security features, and enterprise best practices. Generate scalable microservices in seconds following industry standards.
releaseNotes:
v1.0.1 - Production-Ready Microservice Template
      
      🚀 Features:
      • Clean Architecture with Domain, Application, Infrastructure, and API layers
      • CQRS pattern implementation with MediatR
      • Structured logging with Serilog and multiple enrichers
      • Global exception handling and request logging middleware
      • FluentValidation for robust input validation
      • Health checks with readiness/liveness probes
      • Docker support with optimized multi-stage builds
      • Kubernetes deployment manifests for production
      • GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline with testing and security scans
      • Security headers and CORS configuration
      • Comprehensive unit and integration tests
      • AutoMapper for object mapping
      • Entity Framework Core with repository pattern
      • Caching strategies with decorators
      • Complete documentation and setup guides
      
      🛡️ Security:
      • No vulnerable packages (all dependencies verified)
      • Security best practices implemented
      • HTTPS enforcement and security headers
      
      📦 Template Options:
      • Configurable company and service names
      • Optional Docker and Kubernetes support
      • Database provider selection (SQL Server/PostgreSQL)
      • GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline inclusion
      • Customizable ports and configuration
summary: Enterprise-grade .NET 8 microservice template with Clean Architecture, CQRS, and production-ready features
title: Production-Ready .NET 8 Microservice Template
